title: {session}-lesson-screened.json
description: Step 5 lesson-screener output. Single Haiku call; keep / drop with free-text reason per matched lesson section. Screener emits kept[] as ranges+reason only (no `content`); the orchestrator back-fills kept[].content post-screen via slice-lessons.sh. See apex-core.md step 5 / agents/lesson-screener.md.

line_range.description: Absolute line range in lessons.md, format `start-end` matching the `--- LINES s-e ---` marker from grep-lessons.sh; consumed by update-hit.sh.

section_title.description: Section header line, e.g., `## Canvas / Connection Rules`.

content.description: Verbatim section body (header + lesson lines). NOT screener-emitted - the orchestrator slices it from lessons.md post-screen via slice-lessons.sh over line_range and back-fills it here for the downstream-spawn role (advisory context to steps 6 / 8 / 9 / 10 / 11). Absent in raw screener output; optional.
